node: Regulated utilities and LNG/oil-gas infrastructure capex
summary: Layer 1B expanded the universe around regulated utility and LNG/oil-gas capex by separating one high-attention reference contractor from three less obvious supplier/distributor names. The underfollowed lane emphasizes companies selling enabling hardware, electrical systems, or PVF distribution into utilities, oil/gas, petrochemical, LNG, and energy-transition-adjacent infrastructure. Key chokepoint angle: old-economy utility and hydrocarbon customers can fund recurring capex for grid, gas utility, LNG terminal, pipeline, switchgear, transmission hardware, and maintenance suppliers, while the market may classify these companies as generic industrials or distributors rather than power-capex beneficiaries.
